name: OPNsense
description: OPNsense firewall through its official REST API: ports with link speed, WANs and gateways, VLANs, LAGs, SFP modules, ARP, DHCP leases and pool usage, VPN peers (WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec), services, firewall states, CPU, memory, disks, temperatures, pending updates and uptime; manages local DNS names, wakes devices (os-wol), keeps configuration backups and, on 26.7+, manages each VLAN's network (interface, gateway, DHCP, access rules, mDNS), fixed addresses and paused devices.

name: Horaco switch
description: Horaco HC-SWTGW218AS and managed switches with the same web interface: ports with link speed and connector, traffic counters and MAC table; enables and disables ports, manages 802.1Q VLANs and keeps configuration backups.

name: Mercusys Halo
description: Mercusys Halo mesh systems through their local web interface: every unit, Wi-Fi and wired clients with names, band and rates, CPU and memory. Read-only.

name: MikroTik RouterOS
description: MikroTik routers, switches and access points through the RouterOS v7 REST API: ports with link speed, traffic, SFP diagnostics, VLANs, spanning tree and bonds, bridge MAC table, ARP, DHCP leases, MNDP/LLDP/CDP neighbors, Wi-Fi clients, gateways, CPU, memory, temperatures and pending updates; enables and disables ports, manages switch VLANs and, on routers, each VLAN's network, fixed addresses, local DNS names and paused devices; wakes devices and keeps configuration backups.

name: UniFi Network
description: UniFi Network controllers (UniFi OS consoles or the self-hosted application): every adopted gateway, switch and access point with ports, link speed, spanning tree, LAGs, LLDP and uplinks, Wi-Fi and wired clients with band, signal and traffic, VLANs, WAN status, CPU, memory, temperatures and pending firmware; enables and disables switch ports, manages switch VLANs and each VLAN's Wi-Fi, and keeps configuration backups.

name: OpenWrt
description: OpenWrt routers and access points through ubus (the API LuCI uses): ports with link speed, traffic, bridge VLANs and bonds, WANs and gateways, Wi-Fi clients with signal and rates, ARP, DHCP leases, host names, memory, load, disks and temperatures; enables and disables ports, manages bridge VLANs, each VLAN's network (gateway, DHCP, firewall zone), fixed addresses, local DNS names, paused devices and each VLAN's Wi-Fi; wakes devices (etherwake) and keeps configuration backups.

name: Proxmox VE
description: Proxmox VE hosts and clusters through the official API with a token: node CPU, memory, storage, interfaces and bonds, and every running VM and container placed under the node that runs it; puts a guest's network device in VLANs and keeps configuration backups of nodes and guests.

name: TP-Link Omada
description: TP-Link Omada Software Controller and OC200/OC300 through the official Open API: gateways, switches and access points with ports, link speed, traffic, SFP diagnostics, spanning tree, LAGs, LLDP and uplinks, WANs, Wi-Fi and wired clients, CPU, memory and pending updates; enables and disables switch ports, manages switch VLANs (through port profiles) and each VLAN's Wi-Fi, and keeps configuration backups.

name: pfSense
description: pfSense CE and Plus firewalls through the pfSense REST API package: ports with link speed, WANs and gateways, ARP, DHCP leases and pool usage, VLANs, LAGs, services, VPN peers, firewall states, CPU, memory, temperature and uptime; manages each VLAN's network (interface, gateway, DHCP, access rules), fixed addresses, local DNS names and paused devices, and wakes devices.

name: AdGuard Home
description: AdGuard Home DNS servers: version, local DNS names (rewrites), and DHCP leases, fixed addresses and pool usage when its DHCP server is on; manages local DNS names and keeps configuration backups.

name: Pi-hole
description: Pi-hole v6 DNS servers: version, local DNS records and domain, and DHCP leases, fixed addresses and pool usage when its DHCP server is on; manages local DNS names and keeps configuration backups.

name: Docker
description: Docker hosts and their containers, through the Docker Engine API (behind a read-only socket proxy) or Portainer: containers on an address of their own as devices under their host, with their image, ports and state; the others as the host's services. Read-only.

name: TrueNAS
description: TrueNAS SCALE and Community Edition through the REST API with a read-only API key: system, version and uptime, network interfaces with IPv4 and IPv6, pools as storage, disk temperatures and apps. Read-only.

name: Synology DSM
description: Synology NAS through the DSM Web API: model, serial, version and uptime, CPU and memory, network interfaces, volumes as storage, disk temperatures and Container Manager containers. Read-only.
